lines.zh: 我踩着末地的浮岛边缘走。
lines.en: I walk the edge of an End floating island.
Emptiness below. I don't mind.
My long thin legs walk lightly.
Purple light glints on the rubble.
I circle a black pillar.
My long legs crawl along the wall.
My feet never touch the ground.

lines.zh: 这条裂隙我走过很多次。
lines.en: I've walked this fissure many times.
I walk slowly toward you.
My legs reach out of the dark.
Wind rises from the void.
I walk without sound.
My head hangs between my long legs.
Purple mist coils around my feet.
I don't need to look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 末地高地上没什么东西。
lines.en: There's little on the End highlands.
My fingers move slightly.
I count the fissures in the void.

lines.zh: 这里安静得像没人来过。
lines.en: It's quiet here, as if no one ever came.
I lift my head from the frame.

lines.zh: 光从我骨架的缝里透出来。
lines.en: Light seeps through the gaps in my frame.
I wait by the fissure.

lines.zh: 我站在高地边缘，风穿不过我。
lines.en: I stand at the highland's edge, and the wind can't pass through me.
I spin my silk on the End highlands.
This place never welcomed you.
The End highlands don't welcome the living.
Your breath is short.

lines.zh: 你的心跳顶着你的领口。
lines.en: Your heartbeat pushes at your collar.
Don't look up for anything.
There's nothing here but me.
Your foot missed half a step.
I know you're afraid.
You stand out too bright in the dark.

lines.zh: 你举的东西在轻轻发颤。
lines.en: What you hold is trembling faintly.
I hear the sound of your bones.
On the End highlands, I weave emptiness.

lines.zh: 我低下头，脸凑到你面前。
lines.en: I lower my head until my face is at yours.
You backed away.
You struck my ribs.
My frame rang.

lines.zh: 我的腿又细又长，走得很稳。
lines.en: Long thin legs, and a steady walk.

lines.zh: 我在虚空边上退了半步。
lines.en: I stepped back from the void's edge.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲片掉了几块。
lines.en: A few plates have fallen off me.
My frame is still upright.
You knocked one of my finger bones crooked.
You knocked my finger bone crooked.
That one is carved into bone.
That blow buckled one of my legs.
What you brought is too little.
The End has none of your food.
There's no food in the End.

lines.zh: 末地高地上，我结网等你。
lines.en: On the End highlands, I web and wait.
I won't take what you hand me.
That smell is strange here.
You brought it from the Overworld.

lines.zh: 末地高地上，瘦高的影子。
lines.en: A thin tall shadow on the End highlands.
That's what I want.
You're still holding it up.

lines.zh: 末地高地的腿，撞上来了。
lines.en: An End highland leg just hit you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my leg and took two steps back.
I'm heavier than I look.
Don't touch me.
You slipped between my bones.

lines.zh: 我的骨架硌到了你的肩。
lines.en: My frame caught your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们在裂隙边上撞在一起。
lines.en: We collided at the fissure's edge.
You backed to safe ground.
There's no spare room here.
Come closer and you'll fall.
Too few living things in the End.
Such things don't work here.
I'm only a frame.
Leave these highlands.
The purple mist holds no one.
There's never been a second here.

lines.zh: 我们并排挂在同一面墙上。
lines.en: We hang side by side on the same wall.
The wind scatters words.
Don't bring it up again.

lines.zh: 我吐的线，比你的脚步更早到。
lines.en: My thread arrives before your steps.

lines.zh: 这个掉进裂隙前，我接住。
lines.en: It nearly fell in the fissure. I caught it.
Light as nothing.
This dropped off you.

lines.zh: 末地的土上，我把它放下。
lines.en: I set it back on End stone.
The End doesn't need this.

lines.zh: 它在我指节间变成粉末。
lines.en: It turns to powder between my knuckles.
Bright light is harsh in the End.
I tuck it into my frame.
No one cares about this.
Leave it there.
You moved.
I heard you.
There are no echoes on the End highlands.
You shouldn't run.
You're the only one past the fissure.
Only one way off this path.
I fold my long legs and come closer.
No need to wait for me.
I'll walk right up to you.
Now.

lines.zh: 我落下来，就站在你前面。
lines.en: I drop down and stand before you.
You needn't wait any longer.
I follow behind you.

lines.zh: 我的节肢比你跑得更稳。
lines.en: My joints run steadier than you do.
My legs cover two of your strides.
You turned your head once.
I'm a bit closer now.
You shouldn't run for the edge.
That way is the void.
You stepped on loose stone.
You kicked a stone down the slope.
You stopped before the fissure.
I stopped too.
My long legs close into a ring.
Ten steps between us.
I reach out to grab you.
This grab is slow.
But you can't dodge it.
My fingers closed on you.
You're lifted up.

lines.zh: 我的长腿箍住了你的腰。
lines.en: My long legs cinch around your waist.
Your breathing broke.
I set you down.
The stones there are sharp.
Try standing up again.
I reach again.

lines.zh: 这一下，我抓的是你的手腕。
lines.en: This time I grab your wrist.

lines.zh: 我从紫色的雾里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the purple mist.

lines.zh: 末地高地上多了一道影子。
lines.en: There's one more shadow on the highlands.
My frame turns white in the light.
You're standing across the fissure.
I've come to this side.

lines.zh: 风把我的轮廓吹得很淡。
lines.en: The wind thins my outline.
Few people come here.
And you came.
I lower myself slowly.
I want a clear look at you.

lines.zh: 我从传送的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a teleport seam.
The stone under you cracked.
There is no trace of my shadow.

lines.zh: 火在末地很少见，我退得很快。
lines.en: Fire is rare in the End. I recoiled fast.

lines.zh: 虚空在下面等着，我抓住了边缘。
lines.en: The void waited below. I caught the edge.

lines.zh: 末地没有水，但这水让我僵。
lines.en: There's no water in the End. This one stiffens me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的骨架掀散了半边。
lines.en: The blast blew half my frame apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我肋骨的缝隙。
lines.en: An arrow went through the gap in my ribs.
A flash seared across my bones.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是慢慢变淡。
lines.en: I don't feed. I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷在紫色天空里炸开，我僵住。
lines.en: Lightning burst in the purple sky. I froze.

lines.zh: 虚空就在下面，我快抓不住了。
lines.en: The void is right below. I'm losing my grip.
